title: Cell biology of the nervous system: development, degeneration, and repair
level: Researchers (as stated on the event page)
about: EMBO Workshop "Cell biology of the nervous system: development, degeneration, and repair" will take place in Heraklion, Greece, from 3 to 6 May 2027. Registration closes on 12 February 2027. Applications are made through the event page on the EMBO meetings website.
